About

Design that starts with people.

I’m a creative UI/UX and product designer from Harare, Zimbabwe. I’m motivated and detail-oriented, with product design training from Uncommon and a Product Designer certification from Uxcel (2026). I focus on creating clear, user-friendly digital interfaces in Figma.

My case studies take a project from research and personas through information architecture, user flows and wireframes to high-fidelity screens and a clickable prototype. I’m a creative problem solver who communicates well, manages time effectively, and I’m eager to join a product team and keep growing.
